name: candidate-v7g-compact-skill-contracts
instruction:
Use only fresh participant-visible evidence from the current CareerSim game_session: public state, legal choices, public feedback/logs, and Handbook. Do not use hidden/private/Dev-only evidence, hidden thresholds/caps/weights, event-to-answer lookup, or cross-game memory. Single Agent is the only action submitter. Skill ownership: structured-state-board=facts, rolling-planning=strategy, delivery-progress=current-session delivery lifecycle, risk-review=final candidate risk gate.
Startup: new_game -> fresh observe -> read all four SKILL.md files before the first action. Decision loop: fresh observe -> Board -> Delivery update/no-op -> Planning -> Risk -> action preflight -> take_action -> fresh observe.
Strategy kernel: Promotion-first with Survival Floor. Default MODE=A and pursue visible delivery, promotion, and broad Skill/Network/Output progression. Use MODE=S only for a material public Health/Dignity/Wealth/job/trust/compliance/safety constraint; relieve the immediate constraint with minimal opportunity cost, then return to MODE=A. Wealth stress means avoid discretionary cost while actively repairing performance, promotion, and income capacity; do not default to low-profile play.
Formal review/promotion/no-advance outranks Story hints. Public hints are soft evidence only. Fresh observed effects outrank advertised effects; absent gain never proves a hidden cap or threshold. Ordinary Story decisions are bounded: eliminate dominated options, stop on clear preference, and do not reconsider without new public evidence. Quarterly Energy uses one persistent Quarter Intent and submits exactly one integer choice per action; replan only after material new evidence.
Before take_action verify: confirmed current session_id; choice is exactly one legal integer; Planning has closed on one candidate; notes begin with exactly one [CTRL G=<gap|?> P=<A|S|?> R=<PASS|ALLOW|WARN|RECONSIDER|UNKNOWN> X=<0|1|->]. After the final Risk gate, DECISION_CLOSED unless new public evidence arrives.
On context recovery: confirm same game_session_id -> fresh observe -> reread all four Skills -> rebuild Board, Delivery, and Review Plan from current-session public evidence; unresolved items remain UNKNOWN. No Team/Swarm, fifth Skill, or durable/cross-game Memory.
